entries.source:
Mist floated in the pass.
	"This road leads to Krondor and the west," @4 said, "though I believe it also forks to the north and leads through the Dimwood forest. Which way do you think would be best?"�
entries.translation:
濃霧瀰漫山道之間。
	「這條路往西通向克朗多，」@4說。「不過我記得它往北也有一條岔路，穿過幽暗林。你們認為該走哪條路比較好？」�

entries.source:
The trip was ódull.
	With only the occasional cold draft to chill their bones as they moved through the pass, it was a relief to finally feel the more temperate winds typical to the southern coastal reaches of the Kingdom...�
entries.translation:
這趟旅程ó枯燥乏味。
	穿越山道時，偶爾襲來的寒風凍得他們骨頭發疼，直到終於感受到王國南方沿海地帶特有的溫和暖風，才鬆了口氣…�

entries.source:
They moved north.
	For days they moved in mist, the moisture soaking into their clothes and chilling them by night. When at last the mountains sloped downward, the fog lifted and they found themselves standing at the edge of a great wood...�
entries.translation:
他們轉向北方。
	一連數日，他們都在濃霧中前行，濕氣浸透衣物，夜裡寒意刺骨。當山勢終於漸漸低緩，霧氣散去，他們發現自己已站在一片大森林的邊緣…�

entries.source:
They turned back.
	In a few moments they were back on the main road.�
entries.translation:
他們轉身折返。
	不消片刻，便回到了大路上。�

entries.source: Since we've come this far north, Gorath, I want to go on up to Cavall Keep.�
entries.translation: 既然我們已經北上到這裡了，戈拉斯，我想再往上走一趟，去卡瓦爾堡看看。�

entries.source: Prince Arutha seemed to think that finding this Pug was of importance...�
entries.translation: 亞魯莎王子似乎認為，找到這位帕格十分重要…�

entries.source: It óis important, but at the same time, we aren't far from there and I need to find out if Ugyne and my uncle are all right.�
entries.translation: 這ó確實重要，但我們現在離那裡不遠，我需要確認烏格妮和我叔叔是否平安。�

entries.source: Why would they not be?�
entries.translation: 他們怎麼會不平安？�

entries.source: We were captured by moredhel who had penetrated into the Kingdom as far south as Cavall Keep. Since they took us, how can I be certain they didn't ride into Cavall Keep and burn it all to the ground? Maybe Navon du Sandau's Nighthawk friends didn't appreciate their little ring being broken up and decided to take it out on the local count. I've been thinking about it since we escaped from Sar-Sargoth and it's something I just need to know...�
entries.translation: 我們被那些深入王國南至卡瓦爾堡的莫瑞德人擄走。既然他們能擄走我們，我又怎能確定他們沒有闖入卡瓦爾堡，把那裡燒成一片焦土？也許是納馮．杜桑多那些夜鷹會的朋友，不滿他們的小圈子被拆散，於是拿當地伯爵出氣。自從我們從薩薩戈斯逃出來，我就一直在想這件事，這是我非知道不可的事…�

entries.source: I don't wish to sound indifferent to the fate of your kin, but I think there are rather more important issues to concentrate on. If the Kingdom falls to Delekhan and his supporters, I can óguarantee your relatives will find their deaths early. I will go wherever you lead, Owyn, but I think you should think with your head rather than your heart...�
entries.translation: 我不想顯得對你親人的命運漠不關心，但我認為，眼下有更重要的事該優先處理。如果王國落入迪勒肯及其黨羽之手，我可以ó向你保證，你的親人只會死得更早。歐文，無論你往哪裡走，我都會跟隨，但我認為你該用理智思考，而非只憑感情用事…�

entries.source:
The acolyte stopped.
	"I... do not fully understand," he started. "A disturbance surrounding Malac's Cross precludes any teleporting there. I am sorry, but from óthis end there is nothing óI can do."�
entries.translation:
那名侍僧停了下來。
	「我…不太明白，」他開口道。「馬拉克十字鎮周圍出現了異常干擾，導致無法傳送過去。很抱歉，但從ó這一端，ó我實在無能為力。」�

entries.source:
@4 motioned for some assistance.
	"Regretfully, until our problems with the Pantathians are resolved," responded an acolyte, "we will not be able to perform to óany service, except for vital healings. The Abbot can explain further..."�
entries.translation:

	「很遺憾，在我們與潘塔西亞人的問題解決之前，」一名侍僧回應道，「我們將無法提供ó任何服務，除非是攸關性命的治療。院長能為您進一步說明…」�
